method: All source coordinates are read from unmodified generated drawings, not from construction rectangles or copied guide coordinates. Attempt1 indigo RGB component boxes include dangling bows; their centers are NOT used as ankle-band centers. The wrap bodies were visually read separately, excluding bows/tails, uncertainty +/-0.75 native px. Attempt2 has no bows; source-only indigo-component bbox centers were visually checked, uncertainty +/-0.5 native px. Heel/toe coordinates are approximate visible white-sock heel/toe centerline readings, uncertainty +/-1.0 native px, not certified anatomical joint centers.
